response_extensions: Complete five-choice radio response in all bands. Easy is an authored progression supported by the investigation polynomial exemplar; imported observed labels remain moderate/hard.
banks: Five complete antiderivatives with common powers/signs; distractors apply copied coefficient, multiplied divisor, double division, old exponent, twice-incremented divisor or dropped coefficient errors to this instance. Constants and terms without two-sided error pools are common. Repeated visible families must not share a unique bank-only rank/modal/format/position action.
batch_policy: Validate actual surviving records after publication normalization and deduplication; reject sign-only clones within five consecutive same-band items and missing supported family coverage.
scope: Easy: direct three-term degree-two polynomial, coefficients +/-1..3. Moderate: source polynomial, expanded square and two half-integer profiles. Hard: fractional and reciprocal powers. All require a complete antiderivative including C. No exponent -1, substitution or integration by parts.
source_context: The supplied eligibility ledger excludes no target questions. Partial imports remain unchanged. Source replay is evidence-only. No imported question or other KP job is mutated.
